lines.text: Mbote, ozali malamu lelo?

lines.text: Benga Clarisse, Joël, mpe Grâce liboso likita ebanda.
lines.intent_en: Call Clarisse, Joël, and Grâce before the meeting begins.

lines.text: Nasengi yo otindela ngai facture na e-mail.
lines.intent_en: Please send me the invoice by email.

lines.text: Réunion ekobanda na neuf heures précises.
lines.intent_en: The meeting will start at exactly nine o'clock.

lines.text: Client alobi ete commande na ye ezali en retard.
lines.intent_en: The customer says that their order is late.

lines.text: Nalingi kozwa rendez-vous mpo na lobi.
lines.intent_en: I would like an appointment for tomorrow.

lines.text: Osengeli kosala mise à jour ya application.
lines.intent_en: You need to update the application.

lines.text: Kopesa mot de passe na yo na moto mosusu te.
lines.intent_en: Do not give your password to anyone else.

lines.text: Connexion ezali instable; meká koboma mpe kozongisa Wi-Fi.
lines.intent_en: The connection is unstable; try turning Wi-Fi off and on again.

lines.text: Boss asengi rapport ezala prêt avant midi.
lines.intent_en: The boss wants the report ready before noon.

lines.text: Okoki kofuta na carte bancaire to na cash.
lines.intent_en: You can pay by bank card or in cash.

lines.text: Alobaki: “Je suis désolé,” mpe akangaki telefone.
lines.intent_en: He said, 'I am sorry,' and hung up the phone.

lines.text: Document ezali na pièce jointe ya message.
lines.intent_en: The document is attached to the message.

lines.text: Week-end oyo tokokende kotala libota.
lines.intent_en: This weekend we will go visit the family.

lines.text: Pourquoi otindaki message sans expliquer problème?
lines.intent_en: Why did you send a message without explaining the problem?

lines.text: Directeur azali na bureau te; akozonga sima.
lines.intent_en: The director is not in the office; they will return later.

lines.text: Salá upload ya fichier, sima finá bouton “Envoyer”.
lines.intent_en: Upload the file, then press the Send button.

lines.text: Vol na biso ezali annulé mpo na mauvais temps.
lines.intent_en: Our flight is canceled because of bad weather.

lines.text: Mpo na plus d’informations, benga service client.
lines.intent_en: For more information, call customer service.

lines.text: Fungolá Bluetooth mpo casque ekangama na telefone.
lines.intent_en: Turn on Bluetooth so the headset can connect to the phone.

lines.text: Soki login eboyi, clique na “Mot de passe oublié”.
lines.intent_en: If login fails, click 'Forgot password.'

lines.text: Na réunion ya lobi, tokotala budget, calendrier ya lancement, mpe feedback oyo ba clients batindaki.
lines.intent_en: At tomorrow's meeting, we will review the budget, launch schedule, and feedback sent by customers.
